activities.name: Singapore Science & Engineering Fair Project (Battery Tech)

awards.name: Singapore A-Levels: AAA (H2 Math, Physics, Chemistry) + H3 Engineering A

rationale.intuition: Cornell ED 11.64% overall; intl ED 比 RD intl 3.49% 显著高（ED boost for intl ~2-3x base rate）. Singapore A-Levels AAA (H2 trio) maps to ~3.9-4.0 unweighted in AO conversion. Engineering school (CoE) is more accessible than CAS for intl. SAT 1500 slightly below 25th-percentile (1510) — small offset. Industry: Singapore intl applicants at Cornell ED cluster 5-18%.

sources.name: Cornell CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 8.41%; ED 11.64%; intl admit 3.49%. ED boost for intl approximated at 2.5-3x intl RD rate.

sources.name: Crimson Asia Acceptance Report 2024 — Singapore Cohort
sources.evidence: Singapore A-Levels with H2 AAA + H3 are highly regarded by Cornell engineering AOs; case data shows 6-15% ED admit for strong Singapore engineering applicants.

sources.name: Cornell Office of Admissions International Students Guide 2024
sources.evidence: Cornell accepts A-Levels in lieu of US transcript; H2 grades treated as advanced/AP-equivalent.

wontFixReason: Engine under-predicts Cornell ED for Singapore A-Level applicant (2.61% vs industry [4, 18]). Suspected: A-Level → GPA normalization (AAA → ~3.9) routes to band that misses Singapore intl pool stats. Tier B: verify A-Level grade-band normalization in gpaBandMultiplier and consider intl-CN-applicant-specific path.
